entries.mem0ai/mem0: This universal memory layer provides multi-level storage for user, session, and agent states through an Apache-2.0 self-hosted or managed cloud offering. It utilizes temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval to maintain persistent context across interactions.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: This context database organizes agent data as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and a three-tier loading system (L0, L1, L2) for demand-based retrieval. It is designed to reduce token usage and improve task completion through scoped semantic searches within specific directory subtrees.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee is a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that enables persistent long-term memory for agents without requiring external LLM API keys. It constructs these graphs from text, code, and session history, supporting local operations on Python 3.10 to 3.14.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This memory engine features a custom vector graph engine and byte-level deduplication to achieve sub-300ms recall at high scale. It maintains auto-updated user profiles and supports multi-modal extraction from sources including PDFs, images, and videos.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This project provides synthesized answers with citations and gap analysis by creating knowledge graphs with typed edges without LLM calls. It is designed for multi-user company environments, offering scoped data access for secure information management.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements a workflow of retain, recall, and reflect operations to help agents learn over time. It is compatible with over 25 LLM providers and multiple database backends, accessible via Docker, Kubernetes, and various language clients.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library that uses background reasoning to update peer representations based on session history. It can be deployed via managed service, local CLI, or self-hosted Docker, serving as the upstream library for the honcho-self-hosted Hermes wrapper.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This system manages memory as a git-like repository, utilizing version control operations like commit, branch, and merge over a markdown context tree. It features a 5-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based, achieving sub-100ms performance via a React-powered TUI.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system that uses a single SQLite database for local storage and sub-millisecond performance. It features episodic compression and temporal recall with recency boosting to optimize agent context.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system utilizes Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage structured facts and vector search. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specific injected context and maintains an auto-curated wiki.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that generates filesystem-first artifacts like traces and context bundles. It uses outcome-gated promotion to ensure context changes are only applied based on verified successful trials.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management using a hierarchical Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost. It includes specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall for precise detail recovery within the Hermes Agent.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool retroactively indexes local session history from over 20 coding agents, including Claude Code and Cursor, to enable search across months of past activity. It provides cross-agent recall via MCP tools and CLI search while redacting keys and tokens during the indexing process for safety.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: Honcho provides a self-hosted backend that enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider to maintain persistent agent state.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur utilizes a human-readable YAML engram format to provide a shared memory layer for multi-agent systems. It employs hybrid BM25 and embedding-based retrieval to inject context across global, team, and project-specific scopes.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first layer manages identity, memory, and secrets with a reported 97.6% answer accuracy on LongMemEval benchmarks. It automates memory construction from sources like Discord and Obsidian, offering portable state across Hermes Agent and various MCP clients.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It integrates via MCP and Claude Code hooks, utilizing hybrid retrieval that combines BM25 and vector search.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This five-package plugin family offers durable, file-based memory using a SQLite-backed hierarchical schema and FTS5 search. The architecture is unique for requiring zero vector databases and zero embedding models to function across Linux, macOS, and Windows.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: Focused on inference acceleration, this project optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication to save up to 36% in tokens. It provides native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem, reducing prefill latency by 1.5–3×.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin features explainable retrieval by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every recalled memory. It manages the memory lifecycle through contradiction tracking and hygiene passes, supporting both embedded and HTTP backend configurations.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This CLI serves as a machine interface for agent-driven knowledge maintenance, allowing agents to autonomously evolve persistent, source-grounded archives. It preserves temporal memory and citations without a vector database and supports portable archives for merging data between stores.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as the source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata. It is a daemonless system that employs a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search and retrieval across coding projects.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs in real-time. It uses SQLite-vec and GGUF models for local-first storage and includes an MCP-native server with automated configuration for major coding clients.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack acts as a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner for Hermes Agent. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver purpose-built evidence packets for every query.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This context layer resolves live workspace states into verified facts to reduce prompt token usage by up to 94%. It provides local-first session history tracking and supports MCP-native integration via stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system utilizes BM25 full-text search and ranked graph traversal to manage agent knowledge. It features automated indexing for multimedia with OCR support and uses edge tags to create navigable, bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed to reduce schema overhead, this tool uses local BM25 ranking to select relevant keywords for Hermes Agent v0.14.0. It includes a dedicated dashboard for monitoring estimated token savings and supports native tool search functionality.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed workflow layer manages context for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex using hash-checked proposals. It offers a source-neutral migration path for exporting chats and documents while ensuring reviewed context updates.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a single .lbdb embedded graph database to store memories with a 1-10 importance ranking. It combines BM25 keyword search with optional GLiNER2 entity extraction to surface high-priority entries during context prefetch.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features an on-demand summarizer and a trace.jsonl audit log for tracking all prefetch operations. It distinguishes itself by supporting immediate, real event deletion to prevent old data from affecting future recall.
entries.piprail/piprail: This TypeScript SDK and MCP server enables agents to manage budget-bound wallets for x402 payments across EVM and Solana chains. The system operates without a backend, database, or API keys, allowing agents to pay for API services directly.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin routes agent queries to local skills, runbooks, and scripts through native knowledge search and neighbor traversal tools. It automatically generates routing notes using model calls to facilitate local capability indexing.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables cross-agent continuity by allowing Hermes to read durable memories from other connected agents. It utilizes a local SQLite reliability layer for caching and outbox syncing alongside semantic search capabilities.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes Agent. It supports manual memory storage and retrieval enhanced by configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin adds deterministic slash commands for searching and syncing private local code repositories. It requires a local SourceVault server to provide LLM-callable tools for semantic search and grounded Q&A within codebases.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This memory provider secures long-term data with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports both Rust FFI and HTTP daemon modes. It utilizes HNSW ANN, sparse retrieval, and MinHash deduplication to manage high-density agent context.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal, utilizing a hybrid search approach that combines BM25, vector, and graph methods. It supports automatic context checkpointing during message compression to preserve information integrity.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This file-based system manages memory through a git-backed directory of markdown files, allowing for versioned and diffable updates without a database. It features specialized 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale or conflicting data, providing evidence-cited diffs for manual review.

entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system that generates web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts in formats like HTML, PDF, and MP4. It features a coding-agent CLI and utilizes the DeepSeek Harness for native runtime support in Hermes Agent.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, and ATLAS. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms to enhance cybersecurity capabilities.

entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill manages natural-language mandates, ERC-7710 permissions, and x402 payments. It includes a master router and a verification layer to handle escrow and dispute resolution.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a 112-entry word replacement table. It identifies 74 specific structural and conversational tells through rewrite, detect, and edit-in-place modes.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project enables collective skill evolution by automating deduplication and quality improvements across sessions. It features a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and integrates with Hermes, OpenClaw, and Claude Code.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library offering 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with the agent-plugins.org specification. It maintains session state within the project's documentation folder for persistent agent context.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,174 professional skills distributed as human-readable markdown files under the MIT license. The skills run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code, with ready-to-paste exports for other assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables agents to perform video searches, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlist data. It is compatible with Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, and Cursor, requiring a TranscriptAPI key for operation.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds to streamline skill creation.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project enables type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI with remote registry integration via Git and S3. It provides tools for reading bundled resources and executing scripts within a sandboxed environment to isolate untrusted code from the host.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by generating .lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It features a tangler to extract runnable files from documentation and automatically syncs source edits back to the original literate document.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow skill converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents using Lite or Full complexity modes. It ensures quality through a spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models for project handoffs.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro is a local-first, Git-based harness for long-running agents that operates without a background service. It utilizes a three-layer system of kernels, plugins, and recipes while implementing the SLP protocol for supervised team coordination.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory by capturing high-value decisions and outcomes in markdown files. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning tasks to replacement models based on recorded work history.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides Hermes Agent skills formatted in SKILL.md and supports the agentskills.io standard. It serves Portuguese-speaking users with localized installation guides, configuration instructions, and integrations.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills enable agents to interact with oracle networks and smart contracts via CCIP, Data Feeds, VRF, and Data Streams. The project follows the Agent Skills specification and is installable through the Vercel open skills ecosystem CLI.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This official suite provides eight specialist skills for FLUX image and video generation, including BFL API integration for polling and webhooks. It offers specific prompting guidelines to optimize output for the FLUX 3 video suite.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool automates the creation of agentskills.io-compliant skills by processing repositories, documentation, and developer discourse. It links instructions to specific file lines and includes workflows for briefing, testing, and exporting new skills.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language for AI that operates via a Rust binary using four core verbs: infer, invoke, exec, and agent. It maintains local execution records and journals in a traces directory and supports macOS and Linux environments.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry for reusable AI skills provides a Python client and CLI for installation with recursive dependency resolution. It distinguishes itself by incorporating commerce features that utilize TON payments for skill access.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill manages complex multi-step tasks through autonomous execution with real-time progress and decision tracking. It ensures reliability for long-running operations by providing built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for validating credentials and configuration.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: A community hub for browsing and installing skills, this project implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It features federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face, operating autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client uses a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It utilizes a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incremental metadata retrieval.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle-eye provides a five-layer retrieval system that uses hard triggers and semantic embeddings to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. This approach reduces token consumption and includes graceful degradation if specific dependencies are missing.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as a personal execution system, this project uses an MCP connection to allow Hermes to drive scheduling and habit tracking. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and provides interfaces for both web and Android.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only tool performs adversarial code reviews by deploying three parallel subagents to identify edge cases and integration issues. It combines deterministic scans from multiple security tools with proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes and scores prompts across various interfaces like Discord and Telegram, supporting 97 different languages. It is designed to reduce token usage by 20–80% while evaluating prompt quality across five dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a swarm of three agents to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness across five programming languages. It features a tiered application process that requires an approval gate before changes are finalized.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements systematic investigation protocols and multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python goal engine to maintain persistent task states and prevent early-stop errors during debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern, this project supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI to facilitate tool-based skill loading and automatic directory registration.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey laboratory provides Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to handle real-world exploits.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This toolkit adds session management and worktree recovery to provide memory between agent conversations. It also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and includes scaffolding for building new skills.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent through 11 monitoring tabs covering token costs, session health, and error tracking. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry to ensure data privacy during local development.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for repositories by generating recording scripts via vhs or Playwright. It manages the entire pipeline from rendering and compression to embedding optimized files under 8 MB directly into README markdown.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool enables terminal-based searching of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills for integration with clients like Hermes and Cursor. It streamlines the discovery process by providing direct installation commands for identified tools and plugins.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates portable agent skills from plain language while monitoring official frontmatter specifications to detect and report drift. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes to ensure skills remain compatible with specific runtime profiles.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: Operating locally without external daemons, this project establishes a self-improvement feedback loop by analyzing session history to propose skill coverage updates. Proposed changes are gated behind a framework of deterministic, LLM-judge, and regression evaluators.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This project provides deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. It ensures Hermes Agent can correctly navigate environment-specific syntax and verify project-compatible runtimes without new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses across protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and Hermes Agent to facilitate machine-to-machine financial transactions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection offers specialized tools for video transcription, OCR, and e-commerce content generation. It features a rule-based engine to remove common Chinese AI writing patterns and utilizes macOS Vision to extract structured data from images and PDFs.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project certifies the quality of AI agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to prove a skill is functional and secure.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring an account or API key. It includes tools for managing bounty boards and buying context, with payments distributed to dedicated wallet keys upon human approval.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This integration provides structured web data from 31 platforms through a hosted MCP server exposing 191 distinct tools. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Claude, and Cursor.
entries.superagnt/leverage: This suite provides skills and blueprints for lead enrichment, social data retrieval, and web scraping across platforms like Hermes and Codex. It includes pre-packaged workflows for specific professional tasks such as SEO and sales prospecting.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill enables Hermes Agent to generate multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to align search results with user interests and applies quality gates to produce structured analysis featuring core conclusions and actionable suggestions.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for various AI-powered coding agents, including Hermes, with support for both open-source and unfree licensed tools. The packages are automatically updated on a daily basis to ensure users have access to the latest versions.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running Hermes Agent and other CLIs on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It leverages Termux:API and Termux:GUI to provide the agent with direct access to smartphone hardware and user interface elements.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This tool utilizes a proot-distro Ubuntu environment to install Hermes Agent on Android devices through an automated Termux script. It supports interactive model setup, shell command execution, and integration with both local Ollama models and external providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community-driven Helm chart enables the deployment of Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, featuring configurable gateway modes for API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android and iOS, this project brings Hermes to mobile platforms via Termux and iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and allows for the scheduling of tasks using cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project implements hardware-enforced sandboxing for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell to restrict network and filesystem access at the kernel level. Users can define specific security policies to govern the agent's messaging capabilities and web search activities.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane designed to deploy and operate Hermes agents on Docker and Kubernetes using Helm charts. It features a comprehensive credential catalog, integrations for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and supports persistent state through mounted home directories. It allows users to build specific Hermes versions by utilizing build arguments during the image creation process.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This repository offers a Nix package and NixOS module for reproducible Hermes deployments using declarative configurations for workspaces and settings. It features a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix and systemd for secure secrets handling.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane that manages multiple Hermes Agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It facilitates inter-agent delegation through hierarchy-aware communication and provides enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Designed for production-ready headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is optimized for the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and integrates with Nous Portal.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: This portable distribution allows Hermes Agent to run from a USB drive or any external storage without host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools, supporting Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes within isolated data environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes specialized agents for technical, fundamental, and sentiment analysis to execute financial trading strategies. It ensures point-in-time data integrity during backtesting and supports multiple LLM providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, and cost tracking through a Web UI or CLI. It supports local Node.js installation or Docker deployment, offering memory browsing and MCP server integration for workflow management.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages coding agents like Hermes and Claude using persistent tmux sessions for background execution and container-based isolation. It provides a TUI and web dashboard for overseeing Git worktree management and multi-agent coordination.

entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this project scales Hermes from single VPS agents to automated teams via a task bus delegation pattern. It includes bundled skills for specialized operations such as security auditing, backup management, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the creation of autonomous swarms with durable memory and visual org charts for team delegation. It integrates with over 23 LLM providers and supports MCP tools to extend agent capabilities.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface features a Kanban board for tracking autonomous tasks and a live stream of agent reasoning. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification, requiring manual review for all agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across a strict pipeline architecture for research, planning, and infrastructure tasks. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination of these agents to ensure quality and implementation standards.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It features a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and task flows via a dedicated Kanban interface.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-optimization tool automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena-style framework orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies to vie for GitHub stars. It utilizes Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution, visualizing the competition through a real-time scoreboard and task dashboard.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a 100% local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph that reduces token usage and tool calls for coding agents. It supports cross-file resolution for TypeScript, Python, Go, and Rust, integrating with agents like Hermes via an MCP server.

entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic from coding agents like Hermes, Codex, and Gemini. It ensures security by redacting authentication headers and provides a self-contained HTML viewer for analyzing exported trace sessions.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading the state of Hermes Agent and 37+ other AI tools directly. It supports multi-device synchronization to maintain consistent usage data across different machines.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to help developers build better interfaces with AI. It is compatible with any provider supporting markdown, including Hermes Agent, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.

entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with community-created themes and ASCII art. Using YAML-based configurations, developers can apply diverse aesthetics ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk styles.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 native skills directly into the Claude Code Channel without requiring external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM inference, GGUF, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It facilitates agent commerce through Solana-based payments and identity registration using human-readable handles.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing approvals and checkpoints. It supports external MCP clients and provides built-in integration for providers like Anthropic, OpenAI, and Ollama.

entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve up to 99% token savings during Hermes Agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for DevOps and finance, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder configurations and local skills. It allows for seamless switching between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local memories and custom instructions.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static analysis tool performs deterministic linting of agent configurations and system prompts without requiring runtime model execution. It identifies ambiguous descriptions and contract mismatches, integrating directly into CI workflows via GitHub Actions or pre-commit hooks.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This utility automates the installation of a full hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It provides a zero-cost setup that includes support for 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool facilitates the transition from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent by converting SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into compatible formats. It maps existing configurations into Hermes YAML and JSON while setting up necessary systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability tool uses a native Hermes plugin to export real-time telemetry from agent conversations without cloud dependencies. It features passive analysis and active probing to detect performance drift relative to local configuration changes.

entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant provides an offline, open-mic interface for Hermes Agent with support for 35 languages and wake-word activation. It features adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities without requiring API keys or external accounts.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports multi-dimensional storage and semantic search capabilities. It includes a dedicated circuit breaker for API outages and provides tools for the management and retrieval of agent memories.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This Tauri 2-based manager provides a cross-platform interface for configuring and switching between Hermes Agent and other CLI tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux, serving as an all-in-one desktop controller for agent environments.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that features a built-in agent engine with full file read and write capabilities for Hermes Agent. It enables 24/7 scheduled automation via Cron and supports remote access through a WebUI or various messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Built with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this web interface allows users to access Hermes Agent from browsers or mobile devices without a complex build step. It includes a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure remote access via SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This companion application simplifies the lifecycle of Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider setup. It provides a dedicated GUI for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers in a single desktop environment.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This dashboard offers visual workflow building with human approval gates and scheduling for Hermes Agent tasks. It supports multi-platform channel configuration for services like Telegram and Slack, alongside analytics for tracking token costs and model distribution.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex task handling. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a skills manager to provide a comprehensive development environment.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents into desktop, standalone server, or Docker deployments. It supports fifteen built-in agents and offers native iOS and Android clients for remote session management.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for shell access. It features native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: This Windows-first desktop application is built with Tauri and Rust, featuring a specialized kernel for health checks and updates. The interface supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering while providing native window and process management for Hermes Agent.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension bridges active browser context with local or remote Hermes Agent runtimes. It allows users to switch between multi-agent profiles and use AI-assisted tab scoping to control the context sent to the agent.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app that pairs with a hermes-webui server to drive self-hosted agents from a mobile device. It supports real-time chat streaming with tool-call details and provides mobile management for server workspaces and scheduled tasks.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines, including custom LLM model routing. It features a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, plus a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This terminal-based consciousness monitor features an interactive TUI with nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It provides a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes while tracking growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and system metrics behind a secure login. It features an MCP server control plane for lifecycle management and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that tracks per-session token burn and estimated API costs for Codex and Claude. It allows users to search local agent histories for prompts and tool calls, with support for resuming sessions in Terminal.app, iTerm2, or Warp.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS interface facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It includes an integrated WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It features a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a terminal-based environment for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management and supports the configuration of profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based mobile UI for Telegram supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It features a terminal chat with streaming responses and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs via self-contained Python and Node.js environments without requiring admin rights or Docker. It includes 100 tools for ComfyUI and TTS, alongside a dynamic tool maker for runtime API integration.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for self-hosted assistants. It includes management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers alongside an integrated file browser.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring dashboard provides real-time session activity and cost tracking for Hermes deployments. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, plus read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards for runtime control. It includes an integrated marketplace for MCP servers and isolated profile management for separating sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports model switching with streaming SSE responses.
